text.text_excerpt: HAND GRENADES! I come here every time I visit New Orleans. Hand Grenades are New Orleans most popular drink for those that don't know. There so delicious sweet and pack a punch. You can get the frozen or on the rocks(I recommend on the rocks).There at least 3 locations on bourbon street. I usually visit them all when I'm on Bourbon lol. $10 for a y'all drink you can't beat that with a stick! The cups are cute lime green with a smiling grenade at the bottom. Some people can keep the cups as a souvenirs I just toss mine and keep the party going! If you visit New Orleans please stop by this place you won't be disappointed.

Most people come here for the Hand Grenade, but I was all about that Shark Attack. Apparently the original Tropical Isle does a whole show for this drink, but I didn't want all the bells and whistles, so stopping here worked in my favor. It's a narrow space, but a fun one at the start of Bourbon Street. The bartender was non-nonsense, but excellent. As for the drinks themselves, the Hand Grenade has an energy boost in it, so don't drink it if you're sensitive to caffeine. I rather enjoyed the sweet-and-sour aspect, but it may be too cloying for some. You can order it on the rocks or frozen. Got my hand grenade here. This is a "little" Tropical Isle that has hand grenades and other drinks. Come in. Get your drink, throw your grenade in the overhanging net at the entrance, and take cover. The hand grenade is sweet and strong. If you are brave you can get it without ice. This will be a sugar shock and liquor rush but well worth the extra few dollars.
